text: Employees can submit an expense report with an amount, a category, and an attached receipt image.
Reports under $500 are auto-approved without manager review.
Reports over $500 require manager approval before payment is processed.
note: Contradicted WS-4 on approval composition for reports over $500. Resolved in favor of WS-4 by the BA on 2026-09-18 during Gate A review; flagged for client confirmation at next check-in.

text: Reports over $500 require both manager and finance admin approval before payment is processed.
Managers can see all pending reports from their direct reports in a single list.
The system should be available during normal business hours.
Finance admin should be able to export a monthly report of all approved expenses as a CSV file.
